generate_spec_bindings: run the code generator to produce pybind11 bindings for MuJoCo spec structs
generate_add_constructors: generate add constructors with optional keyword arguments for MuJoCo spec elements
generate_find_functions: generate find functions to locate MuJoCo spec elements by name
generate_signature_property: generate signature property bindings for all MuJoCo spec element types
generate_id_property: generate id property bindings for MuJoCo spec element types excluding plugins
